name: A&W
src: A&W Canada menu and nutrition pages (feed behind web.aw.ca/en/our-menu), per item and per size as listed. Kids' packs are split into their parts (burger or strips, apple slices, MadeGood bar, Milk2Go). Left out: 7 rows with no nutrition figures (plush toys, table spreads) or whose energy does not add up (A&W Root Beer Shake (small) (energy does not add up); Rodeo Rooty (no figures); Paddling Rooty (no figures); Hiking Rooty (no figures); Poutine Rooty (no figures); Fishing Rooty (no figures); Kraft Table Spreads (no figures)). Allergens from A&W's per-ingredient allergen table.
